Pursuant to Regulations 30, 32, 33 and other applicable Regulations of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'), we wish to inform you that Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. Thursday, November 05, 2026, at its Registered Office, which commenced at 4.00 P.M. and concluded at 5.00 P.M., inter alia considered and approved the following:

1) Un-audited standalone financial results of the Company and limited review report thereon from the Auditor for the Half year ended on 30th September, 2026 as recommended by the Audit Committee, and others matters.
